news.title: Rickard Rakell scores in shootout to lift Penguins over Stars, 2-1
news.ruTitle: Рикард Ракелл забивает в серии пенальти и побеждает «Пингвинз» над «Старз» со счетом 2–1.
news.description: — Rickard Rakell scored the deciding goal in the shootout and the Pittsburgh Penguins beat the Dallas Stars 2-1 on Saturday.

news.title: Nylander ties a career high with 5 points, Maple Leafs beat Avs, 6-3
news.ruTitle: Нюландер установил рекорд в карьере с 5 очками, "Мэйпл Лифс" обыграли "Авс" со счетом 6-3.
news.description: — William Nylander and Easton Cowan scored 46 seconds apart late in the second period and the Toronto Maple Leafs beat the Colorado Avalanche 6-3 on Saturday night.

news.title: Snuggerud, Holloway lift Blues to 5-3 victory over Blue Jackets
news.ruTitle: Снаггеруд и Холлоуэй привели «Блюз» к победе над «Блю Джекетс» со счетом 5:3
news.description: — Jimmy Snuggerud scored twice and Dylan Holloway had three assists as the St. Louis Blues beat the Columbus Blue Jackets 5-3 on Saturday night.

news.title: Mammoth bounce back to beat the Sabres 4-1 to close trip
news.ruTitle: «Мамонт» отыгрался и обыграл «Сэйбрз» со счетом 4:1 и закрыл счет
news.description: — John Marino, Anders Lee and Kailer Yamamoto each had a goal and an assist to help the Utah Mammoth beat the Buffalo Sabres 4-1 on Saturday night.

news.title: Jackson Blake and Jordan Martinook have a goal and an assist each as Hurricanes top Blackhawks 5-2
news.ruTitle: Джексон Блейк и Джордан Мартинук забили по голу и сделали результативную передачу, когда «Харрикейнз» обыграли «Блэкхокс» со счетом 5–2.
news.description: — Jackson Blake and Jordan Martinook had a goal and an assist each and the Carolina Hurricanes beat the Chicago Blackhawks 5-2 on Saturday night.

news.title: Kaprizov has 4-point night, Wild top Panthers 4-1 to spoil Florida's home opener
news.ruTitle: Капризов набрал 4 очка, Уайлд Топ Пантерс 4-1 испортили первый домашний матч Флориды
news.description: — Kirill Kaprizov had three goals and an assist, Matt Boldy scored his first goal of the season in the game's first minute, and the Minnesota Wild spoiled Florida's home opener by...

news.title: Macklin Celebrini returns, scores first goal in Sharks' loss
news.ruTitle: Маклин Селебрини возвращается и забивает первый гол в поражении от «Шаркс»
news.description: Sharks star center Macklin Celebrini, 20, San Jose's recently named captain, returned from a two-game absence with a lower-body injury, scoring his first goal of the season Saturday during a 3-1 loss to the Edmonton Oilers at SAP Center.

news.title: Bobby Gould, former Washington Capitals forward, dies at 69
news.ruTitle: Бобби Гулд, бывший нападающий «Вашингтон Кэпиталз», умер в возрасте 69 лет.
news.description: Bobby Gould, who played most of his 11-year NHL career with the Washington Capitals, has died. He was 69.

news.title: McDavid posts 10th assist as Oilers beat Sharks 3-1 for 4th straight win
news.ruTitle: Макдэвид сделал 10-ю результативную передачу, когда «Ойлерз» обыграли «Шаркс» со счетом 3:1 и одержали четвертую победу подряд
news.description: — Connor McDavid recorded his 13th point of the season and 10th assist as the Edmonton Oilers beat the San Jose Sharks 3-1 on Saturday for their fourth straight win.

news.title: Nico Hischier has 2 goals and an assist to help the Devils roll to a 4-1 win over the Canucks
news.ruTitle: На счету Нико Хишира 2 гола и результативная передача, которые помогли "Дьяволам" одержать победу над "Кэнакс" со счетом 4:1.
news.description: — Nico Hischier scored two goals and added an assist while Jesper Bratt had a goal and an assist in the New Jersey Devils' 4-1 win over the Vancouver Canucks on Saturday.

news.title: Fraser Minten has a goal and two assists as Bruins roll past winless Flyers 5-1
news.ruTitle: Фрейзер Минтен забил гол и сделал две результативные передачи, когда Брюинз обыграли безвыигрышный Флайерз со счетом 5-1.
news.description: — Fraser Minten had a goal and two assists, Pavel Zacha scored his first goal of the season and the Boston Bruins beat the struggling Philadelphia Flyers 5-1 on Saturday.

news.title: Rangers' Igor Shesterkin out for season with right knee injury
news.ruTitle: Игрок "Рейнджерс" Игорь Шестеркин пропустит сезон из-за травмы правого колена.
news.description: Rangers goaltender Igor Shesterkin will miss the rest of the season after suffering a right knee injury in Friday night's loss to the Capitals.
